semantic_evidence.carrier_layout: BezierAlgebraicChord2 is one Arc-backed word on the measured 64-bit target and retains two independently defined exact endpoint images without coordinate rounding.
semantic_evidence.authoritative_region_route: CurveRegion2 retains materialized incident Bezier carriers, calls the shared exact_corner_carrier and solve_exact_chamfer_corner authorities, trims with exact or algebraic parameters, and inserts either an ordinary line or one retained algebraic chord.
semantic_evidence.exact_fast_path: Rational contacts stay in Real and do not construct rational source evidence. The algebraic source and its retained parameter Arc are created only after the solver returns a non-Real root.
semantic_evidence.endpoint_validation: An algebraic endpoint is accepted only when its lazy first-order source evidence exactly replays and matches the required source. Equality uncertainty is never converted into equality.
semantic_evidence.classification: The chord supplies conservative bounds, exact point incidence, endpoint-side signs, and an independent-field algebraic forward-ray winding evaluator. Exact endpoints use the ordinary line fast path.
semantic_evidence.topology: Loop roles, fill rules, filled side, seam rotation, and source fragment order survive the rebuild.
semantic_evidence.strict_policy: STRICT executes only proof-producing comparison, root-isolation, source-replay, incidence, winding, and topology paths; an undecidable equality remains blocked.
semantic_evidence.approximate_512_policy: APPROXIMATE_512 executes the identical proof graph and may terminate only through Hyperlimit's shared 512-bit equality decision. Both algebraic fixtures and independent endpoint fields are exercised under this policy without an earlier floating approximation.
